purpose: One integration replay of the completed fixed family, actual source-byte tampering, and immutable evidence/code/claim binding; not a renewed search.
command: timeout 140s python -m unittest discover -s tests/python -p test_pascal_commutator_certificate.py -v
source_mutation: Append one newline to a temporary copy; unchanged declared hashes must not validate changed actual bytes.
preservation: Replay into a new temporary directory, compare deterministic outputs byte for byte, and confirm retained evidence is unchanged. Never update evidence to make the test pass.
unavailable: Replay and source-mutation tests explicitly skip if the git submodule is absent; code/evidence/claim integrity still runs. Skips are not a successful proof replay.
exit: Stop after the three tests or the enforced outer deadline, retaining the test output. Do not retry automatically.
